### Streams in the Desert - January 26
Author: J. R. Miller
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/desert/streams-in-the-desert-january-26th.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 2:31
Points:
- Believers frequently fail to receive God's blessings not only by rushing ahead, but also by hesitating and over-waiting.
- Many divine promises are conditioned upon stepping out in active obedience before the result is visible.
- Faith acts as the key that unlocks God's provision when one moves forward into challenging territory.
- God waits to grant the victory, fighting beside those who boldly advance instead of holding back in fear.
